name: pr-watch
description: Live pane tracking the GitHub PRs touched in a session: CI, review, conflicts, merge. One shared poller for every session on the machine.

poll_active_seconds.title: PR poll interval while something moves (seconds)
poll_active_seconds.description: How often GitHub is asked while a watched PR's CI runs or it is about to merge. Shared by every session on the machine; checked on a 10 s tick.

poll_idle_seconds.title: PR poll interval when idle (seconds)
poll_idle_seconds.description: How often GitHub is asked while no watched PR is moving. Shared by every session on the machine; checked on a 10 s tick.
